m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Well met, young Wizard. Fitzhume told me the Arcanum had a new Initiate. He said you were unworthy, but he can sometimes be... unfair.
Judging by your attire, I can tell you have good fashion sense, and I suspect you have great magical aptitude as well. We will see soon enough.
I am an Arcanum Sentinel, sworn to protect the Spiral, but I also serve as Arbiter Proctis, testing Initiates. Come in and I will test you.
I warn you now. I am here to test the very limits of your magical prowess. I will not pull any punches.
Bravo, Initiate. You have proven Fitzhume's assessment was completely wrong. I have no doubts as to your worth, and your courage.
I will inform the Scholars of your success. They will entrust you with greater responsibilities. Arrivederci. Until we meet again.
You look out and wonder... where are we? Where is the library? But your thinking is too traditional. As an Initiate, you must let that go.
Like the Arcanum itself, this chamber exists in a place of its own, between, beneath, behind, and beyond the rings of the Spiral.
Likewise, your success as an Initiate depends upon your ability to transcend your knowledge, your skills, and your philosophy.
By the flames of Zolivar, you did it, didn't you? I never had any doubts of course, but I know Cyrio turns up the heat on new recruits.
I promise you this though, by joining the Arcanum, you've struck the motherlode of Magic. Your talents will burn like never before.
This little spell here is just the first spark. I be forging new spells all the time, and when you're ready, I'll share 'em with you.
Don't forget, if you find yourself needing a friend, I'm here for you. When we Pyromancers work together, our flames burn all the brighter.
Well, if it isn't the most promising young Pyromancer in all the Spiral. How are you, my friend? I hope the pressure here's not getting to you.
Accomplished as my colleagues may be, they forget that we're not just here to pursue our individual interests. We're here for a common cause.
And seeing as how you just joined us, I was thinking I might share some of me favorite spells. Matter of fact, I got a real sizzler in mind.
But I can't share it with you until you've been approved by the Arbiter Proctis, Cyrio Cassini. Go see him and get tested. I'll be here.
Listen Initiate, you know I be wanting to share me spells with you, but the Arbiter Proctis has to approve of you first. Go see him.
